name: In'youchuu Goku - Kuon no Hime Miko - Tokubetsu Hen
original_name: 淫妖蟲獄 久遠の姫巫女 特別篇
source: After defeating the Hades Oni, the Tsukishiro twins, Ouka and Kikuka, receives a mail from someone who knows about the Oni. Curious to know who sent them the mail, they went to the meeting place where...
translation: 击败冥界鬼后，月城双胞胎樱花与菊花收到一封来自知晓鬼之存在者的邮件。她们好奇发件人身份，前往约定地点，却在那里……
